integrity: The infinite theorem is proved analytically. Exact finite computation is included only as a consistency check and is not used to infer an infinite statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to integer-mean binomial laws with success probability at most one half.
For \(m\ge3\) the theorem proves left-loadedness via condition \(L_1\); it does not establish the stronger all-partial-sums condition \(L_2\).
The proof imports the classical Simmons inequality for the first left-loading coefficient; every new endpoint and U-shape step is proved explicitly.
title: Full resolution of the binomial left-loadedness conjecture
